clips.title: The story
paras: In Razor Hill, Kaplak trains young orc and troll rogues for the Horde. He teaches stealth, subterfuge, and bladecraft before sending them to Orgrimmar.

Kaplak trains new Horde rogues in Razor Hill. Orcish custom favors open combat and roaring charges, but he teaches the quieter skills needed to survive: stalking unseen, picking locks, and striking from behind. When his students outgrow his training in Durotar's dusty red ravines, he sends them north to Orgrimmar, where senior guild operatives can deepen their craft.
